system.title: Design system
system.subtitle: Every token, type role, and layout rule in one place. Open Theme to edit any primitive or semantic token.
system.color.lead: One accent carries focus. Surfaces stay quiet so data and status can speak.
system.contrast.title: Contrast pairs
system.contrast.lead: WCAG 2 ratios for the pairs that actually render as text or icon on a fill. Failures are reported, not corrected.
system.type.lead: Point a type role at Font Sans, Font Serif, or Font Mono to restyle that text. App chrome uses Font Sans; code uses Font Mono.
system.type.scaleLead: Fixed steps are the primitives. Each size is declared once.
system.type.fluidLead: From XL up, each step has a fluid variant that grows with the viewport and tops out at the fixed size.
system.type.rolesLead: Roles point at a step on the scale. Page-level hierarchy uses fluid steps; dense UI stays fixed.
system.space.lead: Eight-step scale, drawn at actual size. Space 2 aliases the primary base space. Card padding and gap stay semantic.
system.shape.lead: Cards 8px, controls and inputs 4px, chips and nested tiles 4px, avatars full. Cards are flat; popovers carry the md shadow, modals lg.
system.shape.radiusRule: The card is the only outer frame. Inner radius is for nested tiles and clipped map or chart hosts.
system.layout.lead: Primary content sits on a 12-column grid, capped at the content max. Breakpoints live in code, not in CSS variables inside queries.
system.layout.gridMeta: {{columns}} columns. Default span {{span}}. Wide span {{wide}}. Max width {{max}}.
system.icons.lead: Material Symbols Outlined, the variable icon font, at 16px and weight 400 in currentColor. Hover a tile for the hover state, press for the filled active state. Click to copy the component.
tour.theme.title: Theme
tour.theme.body: Open the control panel to view and edit every primitive and semantic token, with derived variables shown alongside. Use Dark mode to switch palettes.
